about: pnpm bench:request (packages/evals/src/request-bench.ts). Milliseconds per HTTP edit (replace_clip_keyframes of 1 key and of 2000 keys on the keyframes proof's project, agent token, connection: close, body serialised inside the timing), per listener mode, over `runs` edits after 3 warm-ups, each mode measured `samples` times on a fresh project. Server timers are the real instances wrapped: commitAs (governance + Store.commit), commit (Store.commit, including emit), emit (Store.drainOutbox: the events and the SSE writes it starts), getProject (whole-document reads). wholeReads counts GET /projects/:id made by the listener during the runs. profile: self time of the 2000-key runs in this process (server and client), by function and by file. One machine, one sample of it, under whatever else ran.
note: Labels: before-profiled = the code before this change (the editor read the whole project on every revision event), with a CPU profile of the 2000-key runs (modes none, sse, editor-node; the browser mode of that run was not kept); after-profiled = this change, with its profile; ab-<version>-<round> = before and after run alternately, three rounds, the same build of each, so that drift in machine load (other agents) falls on both alike. summary = per mode and version, every sample of the HTTP delta (2000-key p95 minus 1-key p95, and the p50 delta) and their medians, computed from the ab rows above.

keyframesProofSamples.about: pnpm proof:keyframes, three runs one after another on this change (after pnpm build), with the 1-minute/5-minute/15-minute load average at the start of each (other agents ran on the same 4 CPUs). The proof times 20 edits of each size after 3 warm-ups; its delta is p95(2000 keys) − p95(1 key). Run 2 went over the gated sampler ns/sample (Node) budget under that load; run 3 passed every gate. The evidence file docs/evidence/keyframes-proof.json was left as committed.
